name: Grenada
summary: French settlement, British conquest, French recapture, British restoration.
notes: The track represents Grenada and its associated southern Grenadines. Fédon’s rebellion controlled much of the countryside but not the colonial capital; the 1983 invasion did not annex Grenada.

events.title: Spain claims Grenada
events.detail: Columbus sighted the island, without establishing a Spanish colony.
events.qualification: A European claim; it does not establish island-wide administration or extinguish Indigenous rights.

events.title: French colonization begins
events.detail: Du Parquet’s expedition established a colony, followed by violent dispossession of Kalinago inhabitants.
events.uncertainty: The museum explains why older accounts say 1650; this dataset follows 1649.

events.title: Britain captures Grenada
events.detail: The island fell during the Seven Years’ War.

events.title: France cedes Grenada
events.detail: The Treaty of Paris confirmed British possession.

events.title: France retakes Grenada
events.detail: D’Estaing’s forces captured the island in the American Revolutionary War.

events.title: Britain returns after the peace
events.detail: The 1783 settlement was implemented with British restoration.

events.title: Fédon’s rebellion
events.detail: A major uprising challenged British rule and plantation slavery; it was defeated in 1796.

events.title: Grenada becomes independent
events.detail: Associated statehood was followed by sovereignty.

events.title: U.S. and Caribbean forces invade
events.detail: Foreign forces overthrew the military government after the killing of Maurice Bishop; Grenada remained a sovereign state.
